verdict.rationale: Desktop sync clients are a fair question for a document and file-sharing platform like SharePoint, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only REST/Graph APIs, webhooks, and general community sentiment. Nothing documents an official macOS or Windows sync client, selective sync, or on-demand (online-only) files.

support.subject: As a power user, sync just works on my machines — official desktop clients across macOS/Windows with selective sync and on-demand (online-only) files
